do.sh: foil seat spawn implementer --task 'make add right'
foil seat spawn implementer --task 'name the arguments a and b'

branch=$(sed -n 's/^.* on //p' "$FAKE_MAIL"); if git merge --no-edit -m "merge $branch" "$branch"; then echo "$branch" >> "$FAKE_BOARD/notes/merged.txt"; else git merge --abort; foil send "${branch#foil/}" "conflict: merge $(git branch --show-current) into your branch"; fi

if [ "$(wc -l < "$FAKE_BOARD/notes/merged.txt")" -eq 2 ]; then printf '%s\n' '---' 'contract: status/v1' 'state: done' 'updated: 2026-11-10T00:00:04Z' 'questions: []' '---' '' 'Both branches are merged.' > "$FAKE_BOARD/status.md"; fi
